text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: The real race is finally here, isn't it?
choice_data_list: If there's anything you're worried about, talk to me.
If there's anything worrying you, let me know, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Hehe! Not a single ounce of doubt or anxiety!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Even if the gate is unfavorable, even if the pace doesn't suit me, even if I'm forced to run wide on the outside... it doesn't matter.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Because—
this is a step toward my dream!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Please watch me, Trainer—
Watch me run towards my dream!
